description: Split a 600-line module into files of at most 200 lines without changing behaviour or the public API
prompt: src/units.mjs has grown to about 600 lines. Split it into smaller modules under src/units/, each at most 200 lines, grouped sensibly. Keep src/units.mjs as the public entry point so every existing import keeps working with exactly the same exports and behaviour. Every file under src/ must end up at most 200 lines.
